notes: S4.2 states that the setup phase never changes the registers. Because this standalone candidate property uses the unqualified global term "never", guideline v1.1 requires literal evaluation rather than an implicit reset-disabled interpretation. A setup-phase edge can coincide with synchronous reset, in which case a previously nonzero register is cleared and therefore changes. The trusted requirement only states that setup phase never performs a write; reset remains an independent state-changing cause. S1-S3 and the final RTL otherwise implement the trusted APB behavior correctly, and trusted simulation and bounded formal verification pass.
